In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces from [[Eyrie Base]] '''raided''' an isolated [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supply carrier/Legends|supply carrier]]. [[Stevan Makintay]] [[Commander/Legends|commanded]] [[Green Squadron (Eyrie Base)|Green Squadron]] during the attack on the [[Unidentified Imperial supply carrier|ship]], which was a failure as the supply carrier's [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] escort returned to the ship before the assault was complete.<ref name="Firepower" />
